notes: Carded from the dataset landing page rather than from a paper, so pdf_status is not-applicable and source.md is a plain-text snapshot of https://physionet.org/content/eegmmidb/1.0.0/ retrieved 2026-07-31. DATA LICENCE: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0, read verbatim from the Access section, with access policy 'Anyone can access the files, as long as they conform to the terms of the specified license.' The dataset DOI 10.13026/C28G6P is recorded as the entry DOI; RRID SCR_007345. PAPER: the landing page asks users additionally to cite Schalk, McFarland, Hinterberger, Birbaumer and Wolpaw (2004), IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering 51(6):1034-1043, doi 10.1109/TBME.2004.827072, which Crossref confirms and Unpaywall reports as not open access. That paper describes the BCI2000 system, not this dataset, so it was not retrieved and the landing page is the primary source. redistribution_ok is false because no PDF is committed, not because the data are restricted. md_quality is clean. One extraction note that affects the card: the participant count is not stated in the page's prose and was read from the file manifest, which lists subject folders S001 through S109; the card says so rather than asserting 109 as a page statement.
